mapper.select: SELECT CAST(ad.authority_id AS CHAR) AS authorityId, ad.authority_name AS authorityName, ad.authority_code AS authorityCode, CASE WHEN uae.is_excluded = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS excluded FROM authority_dict ad LEFT JOIN user_authority_exclude uae ON uae.authority_id = ad.authority_id AND uae.camp_id = #{campId} AND uae.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ad.authority_type = 'notification' AND ad.status = 1 ORDER BY ad.module_name ASC, ad.seq_no ASC, ad.authority_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_authority_exclude ( id, camp_id, user_id, authority_id, is_excluded, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{campId}, #{userId}, #{authorityId}, 1, NOW(), #{userId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_excluded = 1, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{userId}
